domain_notes: AI data hall fit-out with 2N power. New racks (0.6 m wide x 1.2 m deep, rot 0) go in rows centered under an A/B busway pair: BW_<row>1 is feed A at row_y-0.25, BW_<row>2 is feed B at row_y+0.25. 2N: every rack takes two feeds, one from its row's A busway and one from its B busway, each within tap_m; either feed alone must carry the rack's full load, so each busway's assigned load <= capacity_kw*derate (continuous). Liquid-cooled racks (132-142 kW) need a CDU: assigned load <= capacity_kw, total liquid load must survive loss of the largest CDU (N+1), and the Manhattan hose run from rack center to CDU port <= hose_m. Air-cooled racks (~15 kW) need no CDU but their total load must fit in the room's air_cooling_kw. Hot/cold aisles: adjacent rows alternate orientation (fronts face fronts across a cold aisle, backs face backs across a hot aisle); racks in a row abut (gap 0) and aisles between rows are >= aisle_min_m. Pillars split rows; keepouts (slab limits, NEC 110.26 working space) and egress corridors must stay clear.
